title: A Boundary-Layer Mechanism for One-Third Scaling in Online Softmax Classification
abstract: arXiv:2605.22341v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Hard-label classification is usually trained with smooth surrogate losses such as softmax cross-entropy. We isolate a mechanism by which this mismatch between smooth surrogate and discrete labels produces power-law learning curves for a one-layer softmax student trained by online SGD on Gaussian inputs with argmax teacher labels. In the thermodynamic limit, the dynamics reduce to a growing student-teacher alignment and a residual student variance sustained by SGD noise. At late times, only shrinking layers of examples around teacher decision boundaries remain active. This yields an $\alpha^{-1/3}$ law in training time $\alpha$ not only for the test loss but also for the generalization error, one minus test accuracy. The error law is an online-noise effect. The loss law persists without gradient noise. Learning-rate annealing separates the two exponents, improving the error exponent from 1/3 toward 1/2 while slowing the loss. Simulati

translated_title: 在线Softmax分类中三分之一标度律的边界层机制
translated_abstract: 硬标签分类通常使用平滑代理损失（如softmax交叉熵）进行训练。我们分离出一种机制，用以解释平滑代理与离散标签之间的失配如何为单层softmax学生模型产生幂律学习曲线——该模型通过在线SGD在带argmax教师标签的高斯输入上进行训练。在热力学极限下，动力学可简化为不断增长的学生-教师对齐，以及由SGD噪声维持的残余学生方差。在训练晚期，只有教师决策边界附近不断收缩的样本层仍然活跃。这使得测试损失以及泛化误差（一减测试准确率）均呈现关于训练时间α的α^{-1/3}幂律。其中误差定律是在线噪声效应，而损失定律在无梯度噪声时依然存在。学习率退火可将两个指数分离，把误差指数从1/3改善至接近1/2，同时减缓损失的下降。
tldr: 论文揭示了平滑代理损失与离散硬标签的失配使在线SGD训练的softmax学生模型在训练晚期仅由教师决策边界附近不断收缩的样本层驱动学习，导致测试损失和泛化误差均呈α^{-1/3}幂律标度；其中泛化误差的1/3指数是SGD在线噪声效应，可通过学习率退火将其改善至1/2。
en_tdlr: The mismatch between smooth surrogate losses and discrete hard labels drives an online-SGD-trained softmax student to learn only from shrinking boundary layers around teacher decision boundaries, producing α^{-1/3} power-law scaling in both test loss and generalization error, where the 1/3 error exponent is an SGD online-noise effect that learning-rate annealing can improve toward 1/2.
